Handshake: transfer occurs on rising edge when valid and ready both high. Source must hold valid and data/sidebands while stalled, unless reset asserted. Receiver may stop for any number of cycles.

Availability: m_valid high exactly when buffered words exist. Head data and sidebands remain stable while stalled. No direct input-to-output bypass allowed.

Ready: s_ready must be high exactly when reset is low and either there is unused capacity or an existing head word will be consumed on this edge. Full-capacity simultaneous dequeue/enqueue must be supported.

Ordering: Each accepted word appears once and in order unless flushed by reset. New traffic must work after reset; tying off ready or valid cannot satisfy the contract.
